pricing_page.browser_click_path: Direct navigation to /payments-billing via headless browser (page found by web search); page is a JS-rendered Homestead template so raw HTML had no visible text and the rendered accessibility snapshot was read instead.

page_facts: Page section 'PRICING TRANSPARENCY' names Rush County Memorial Hospital and quotes ACA Section 2718 standard-charge language.

'Price Listing' block offers exactly two facility links: (1) 'Price Transparency Tool' -> https://apps.para-hcfs.com/PTT/FinalLinks/RushCounty_V2.aspx (the known PARA route, chargemaster labeled 11/1/2020), and (2) 'Charge Master 2020' -> https://storage.googleapis.com/wzukusers/user-35203654/documents/90ebdb25dee4402fb0ebb42124923a19/Charge%20Master%202020.xlsx with text '(This list of charges is current as of 01/01/2020)'.
No cms-hpt.txt link, no CMS-format CSV/JSON MRF, and no declared CMS template version appears anywhere on the page.
what_changed_versus_prior_proof: Prior proof (2026-09-21) covered only the PARA publisher route (browser navigation-timeout there). This is new first-party evidence: the hospital's own pricing page was rendered for the first time, its complete link inventory was recovered, and it confirms the first-party route offers only the same PARA V2 tool and a 2020-01-01 charge master. Nothing on the page establishes a current CMS-format MRF.
not_established: No current CMS-template CSV/JSON MRF exists in machine-retrievable form for CCN 170781.
The xlsx charge master was not downloaded or parsed (historical 2020 file; bounded retrieval rule and no promotion intent).
No compliance conclusion is drawn either way.
interpretation: First-party evidence corroborates the prior finding: only historical (2020) charge data is published on the official site. Not promotable; the pointer-retrieval gate remains open.
next_action: The only remaining route is an authorized/outreach request to the hospital for a current CMS 3.0.0 CSV/JSON MRF URL; alternatively recheck the PARA RushCounty_V2.aspx page only if PARA refreshes it past the 11/1/2020 chargemaster date.
